findings.message: INI directive 'safe_mode' is deprecated since PHP 5.3 and removed since PHP 5.4 (ini_get()/ini_set() of a directive that no longer exists returns false without an error, and this directive was already gone before PHP 8.3, so the upgrade changes nothing)

Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_args(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$product_id" was changed on line 67. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: func_get_args() and similar report the current value of a changed parameter, and code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this, so the upgrade changes nothing)
Guarded (only runs when the old feature is available, so it is skipped on newer PHP): INI directive 'auto_detect_line_endings' is deprecated since PHP 8.1
